title: Sable and the Static
author: Oscar Zhou
blurb: Odile Vasquez, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
